He is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] who [[Type expert|specializes]] in {{type|Steel}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. [[Sophocles]] affectionately refers to him as '''Big Mo''' (Japanese: '''マーさん''' ''Mu-san''). He also becomes a member of the [[Alola]] [[Elite Four]] in [[Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon]]. ==In the core series games== Molayne is a former [[Trial Captain|captain]], who runs the [[Hokulani Observatory]], and manages the [[PC]] box system in [[Alola]]. He is a friend of [[Professor Kukui]], the two having taken their [[island challenge]] around the same time. He will give the {{player}} a [[Steelium Z]] after{{sup/7|SM}}/before{{sup/7|USUM}} taking on [[Sophocles]]'s trial. After the player has cleared the trial, Molayne also asks the player to deliver Kukui [[Professor's Mask|the mask]] he accidentally left behind. In {{g|Sun and Moon}}, Molayne is one of the many {{pkmn|Trainer}}s who [[Pokémon League (Alola)/Title Defense|challenge]] the player for the title of [[Pokémon Champion]]. In {{g|Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon}}, Molayne instead becomes a member of [[Alola]]'s newly founded [[Elite Four]] by Professor Kukui's request, replacing [[Hala]] from Sun and Moon. Unlike most other characters, Molayne is aware of Kukui's secret identity as the [[Battle Royal]] master "Masked Royal", even sometimes referring to Kukui by his alias. ===Pokémon=== Molayne's Pokémon {{color2|000|Pokémon Sun and Moon|Sun, Moon}}, {{color2|000|Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon|Ultra Sun, and Ultra Moon}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Molayne/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== [[File:Molayne anime.png|thumb|250px|Molayne in {{aniseries|SM}}]] ====History==== ====={{aniseries|SM}}===== Molayne first appeared in a picture in ''[[SM067|Love at First Twirl!]]'', where he was introduced as {{an|Sophocles}}'s cousin and a close friend of {{an|Professor Kukui}} during Sophocles's class presentation. Molayne made his physical debut in ''[[SM079|Showering the World with Love!]]'', where he showed {{Ash}} and {{ashcl}} around the [[Hokulani Observatory]] and, by Kukui's request, also taught them about the life cycle of {{p|Minior}}. In ''[[SM092|Turning the Other Mask!]]'', Molayne helped Kukui keep his Masked Royal identity a secret from Ash and {{an|Professor Burnet}} during a handshake event. Molayne came up with a plan that would allow Kukui to be present when Burnet shook the Masked Royal's hand which involved him taking over for Kukui as the Masked Royal. The next day, Molayne met up with Ash and Burnet and sat with them as Kukui wouldn't be present until the last minute. Molayne sat with them whilst Masked Royal and {{TP|Professor Kukui|Incineroar}} put on a demonstration. During the event, Molayne attempted to take Kukui's place as the Masked Royal but was tied up by [[James]] and {{an|Faba}}, who had mistaken Molayne for an impostor. Later, when [[Mad Magmar]] attacked the event to get revenge on the Masked Royal, Kukui was unable to fight back since Faba had his Incineroar and costume at the time. After Molayne managed to free himself, he used his {{p|Magneton}} to turn the lights off, allowing Kukui to get his Masked Royal costume back in time to defeat Mad Magmar. In ''[[SM145|Dreams of the Sun and Moon!]]'', Sophocles mentioned plans to visit [[Mossdeep City]] and the [[Mossdeep Space Center]] with Molayne for his upcoming vacation. In ''[[SM146|Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!]]'', Molayne was shown leaving Alola with Sophocles. ====={{aniseries|JN}}===== In ''[[JN096|Lighting the Way Home!]]'', Molayne appeared in a flashback when Sophocles told Ash and [[Goh]] how he had borrowed Molayne's {{p|Ampharos}} for use at the Mossdeep Space Center. ====Character==== Molayne tends to keep to himself and is notably cautious. However, he will go out of his way to help a friend, such as when he offered to impersonate Masked Royal for {{an|Professor Kukui}} during a meet-and-greet event in ''[[SM092|Turning the Other Mask!]]''. His ingenuity and extensive knowledge on space is respected, especially by his young cousin {{an|Sophocles}}, who refers to Molayne as '''Big Mo''' (Japanese: '''マーさん''' ''Mul-san''). ====Pokémon==== =====On hand===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Molayne |pkmn=Magneton |type1=Electric |type2=Steel |img=Molayne Magneton.png |epnum=SM079 |epname=Showering the World with Love! |vajp=Kei Shindō |vajp2=Reina Ueda |vajp3=Hitomi Kikuchi |vaen=Bill Rogers |desc={{p|Magneton}} is Molayne's first known Pokémon. It was first seen interacting with {{an|Sophocles}}'s {{TP|Sophocles|Togedemaru}} after she had absorbed {{AP|Pikachu}}'s electricity, causing everyone around them to get shocked. Magneton reappeared in ''[[SM092|Turning the Other Mask!]]'', where it caused the lights to go out at the {{ci|Hau'oli}} Mini-Mini [[Battle Royal Dome]], allowing Kukui to change into Masked Royal and defeat [[Mad Magmar]]. None of Magneton's moves are known.}} =====With Sophocles===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Molayne |pkmn=Ampharos |type1=Electric |img=Molayne Ampharos.png |epnum=JN096 |epname=Lighting the Way Home! |vajp=Risa Shimizu |vaen= |desc={{p|Ampharos}} is a Pokémon belonging to Molayne that Sophocles borrowed for a project at the [[Mossdeep Space Center]]. It was used to help guide the {{p|Talonflame}} 2 probe back to the planet. After the equipment broke down, Ampharos temporarily lost its confidence, but with help from {{AP|Pikachu}}, {{TP|Sophocles|Togedemaru}}, and {{TP|Goh|Raichu}}, it was able to guide the probe down. None of Ampharos's moves are known.}} ====Voice actors==== {{vatable|color={{steel color light}}|bordercolor={{steel color}} |ja=桑野晃輔 ''Kōsuke Kuwano'' |en=[[Barrett Leddy]] |fi=Tuukka Leppänen |fr_eu=Gauthier de Fauconval |es_la=Dan Frausto |es_eu=Álvaro Navarro |pt_br=Mckeidy Lisita}} ===GOTCHA!=== Molayne briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Molayne Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Molayne in Pokémon Adventures]] Molayne debuted in ''[[PASM19|Truth and the Mastermind Behind Team Skull]]''. He and [[Sophocles]] were first seen helping innocent civilians escape from the [[Ultra Beast]]s that had escaped from [[Po Town]] to wreak havoc on [[Ula'ula Island]]. They managed to evacuate the people to [[Hokulani Observatory]], but with the beasts still on the loose, they worried that it may eventually get attacked as well. To circumvent this problem, Sophocles decided to use an invention designed to call Totem Pokémon to guide the beasts away from the observatory, though it never worked. In ''[[PASM22|The Truth and Island Kahuna Hapu]]'', Molayne, Sophocles, [[Acerola]], [[Professor Kukui]], and [[Gladion]] fought off a {{p|Celesteela}} and {{p|Guzzlord}} at {{rt|10|Alola}} to prevent them from reaching Hokulani Observatory. Gladion easily defeated Celesteela and later defeated Guzzlord to prevent it from hurting [[Lillie]]. Later, Sophocles and Molayne told the [[Trial Captain|captains]] and [[island kahuna]]s to gather at Hokulani Observatory. With a {{p|Vikavolt}}-shaped airship, Molayne and Sophocles took the others to [[Mount Lanakila]], where a wormhole had opened up earlier. Shortly after they arrived, their ship was attacked by a group of {{tc|Aether Foundation Employee}}s and their Ultra Beasts. With the [[Z-Move]]s they had acquired, Molayne and the others managed to defeat the Ultra Beasts. ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Molayne |width=74 |pkmn=Dugtrio |type1=Ground |type2=Steel |img=Molayne Dugtrio Adventures.png |epnum=PASM19 |epname=Truth and the Mastermind Behind Team Skull |desc=This {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Dugtrio}} is Molayne's only known Pokémon. It was first seen with its Trainer watching people be evacuated to [[Hokulani Observatory]]. It later fought against a {{p|Celesteela}} and {{p|Guzzlord}} to prevent them from attacking Hokulani Observatory, but was defeated. Later, it fought an {{tc|Aether Foundation Employee}}'s {{p|Nihilego}} and won with the help of a [[Z-Move]]. None of Dugtrio's moves are known.{{tt|*|Dugtrio is implied to know a Steel-type attack due to the use of Corkscrew Crash}}
Dugtrio can also perform the [[Z-Move]] {{m|Corkscrew Crash}}.}} ==In the TCG== [[File:MolayneUnbrokenBonds212.jpg|200px|thumb|Full Art print of Molayne]] {{main|Molayne (Unbroken Bonds 181)}} '''Molayne''' was introduced as a {{TCG|Supporter card}} in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] during the English Sun & Moon Series (the Japanese SM Era). It was first released in the Japanese {{TCG|Full Metal Wall}} subset before debuting in English in the {{TCG|Unbroken Bonds}} expansion, with artwork by [[Ken Sugimori]]. It was also released as a {{TCG|Full Art card}} in the same Japanese and English expansion, with artwork by [[Masakazu Fukuda]].
